name: Golden Designs Bergamo Elite 4-Person Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna | DYN-6440-01 Elite
description: Golden Designs Dynamic Bergamo Elite 4-person Ultra Low EMF (Between 3-5MG) FAR Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) The Golden Designs Bergamo Elite is a spacious and luxurious wellness sanctuary, expertly designed to accommodate up to four people in comfort and style. Crafted with natural, reforested Canadian Hemlock wood, this sauna offers a beautiful, durable, and non-toxic cabin that becomes a centerpiece of shared relaxation. Its advanced therapeutic power comes from eight Dynamic Ultra Low EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels, which provide a gentle yet deeply penetrating heat to promote detoxification and well-being. This cutting-edge technology maintains an exceptionally low electromagnetic field level, specifically between 3-5 MG, ensuring a safe and effective session. The Bergamo Elite is engineered for an elevated and immersive user experience. Its striking bronze-tinted tempered glass door and exterior accent lighting create a modern, premium aesthetic that enhances any room. The interior is a hub of wellness technology, featuring dual LED control panels for effortless management of settings and a multi-functional chromotherapy lighting system with a powerful red light therapy feature. With its spacious design and integrated Bluetooth audio system, this sauna provides a complete sensory retreat for family and friends to enjoy together. Features Delivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. Capacity: Full 4 person capacity Heating Elements: 8 Dynamic PureTech™ Ultra Low EMF (EMF between 3-5MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels 3 on the rear wall 1 on each side wall 1 under the bench and 2 on the floor board Wood Type: Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Glass: Bronze Tinted Tempered glass door and with side windows Interior Lighting: Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Feature Exterior Accent Lighting Control Panels: Interior / Exterior LED control panels Sound System: Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Temperature Range: 118F-132F is the deal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Electrical Service: Special Electrical 120 V/20 AMP Non GFCI dedicated receptacle and breaker (Not 220/240 V) (Please consult a certified electrician.) Location: Indoor Use Only Roof vent Specifications Ideal Temperature Range 118°F - 132°F, sauna can heat up to 140°F Exterior Dimensions (LWH) 42" x 70" x 75" (roof overhang: adds 4.3" to length) Interior Dimensions (LWH) 38" x 66" x 69" Sauna Weight 410 lbs. Shipping Weight 515 lbs. Ships in 3 boxes Assembly & Maintenance Assembly Bergamo Elite Owners Manual Maintenance Since infrared saunas do not require hot rocks, water, or steam to operate, they require very little maintenance. You can simply wipe it down with water - use a damp, soft, and clean cloth. Do not use any chemical-based cleaning agents as they can be absorbed into the wood and released into your sauna during use. Warranty 5-Year Limited Warranty: Golden Designs, Inc. under the Dynamic brand name warranties the wood, structure, heating elements, and electronics against defects in material and workmanship from the original date of purchase.
